Definition: perhaps from the same as G2053 (through the idea of hairiness); a kid or (genitive case) goat:--goat, kid.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, ériphos means a kid or goat. It occurs twice, in Matthew and Luke.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold ériphos to its plain sense and let the passage speak for itself.
RelatedEvents: The Prodigal Son; The Sheep and the Goats
